# clio inspect

metadata-only listing, no decrypted body

## Usage

```
clio inspect [--filter JSON] [--category C] [--epistemic-kind K] [--validity V] [--time-start TS] [--time-end TS] [--limit N] [--offset N] [--include-discarded] [--bank BANK] [--output json|text]
```

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--filter JSON` | text |  | Supplies the inspect filter as a JSON object; `cli_read_core::parse_filter` accepts the keys category, epistemic_kind, validity, time_start, time_end, and include_discarded. |
| `--category C` | text |  | Filters by semantic category; `cli_read_core::inspect_call` adds it to the `inspect` filter. |
| `--epistemic-kind K` | text |  | Filters by epistemic kind; `cli_read_core::inspect_call` adds it to the `inspect` filter as `epistemic_kind`. |
| `--validity V` | enum: all, active, invalidated, discarded |  | Filters by validity; `cli_read_core::inspect_call` accepts `all`, `active`, `invalidated`, or `discarded`. |
| `--time-start TS` | text |  | Sets the lower time bound; `cli_read_core::inspect_call` adds it to the `inspect` filter as `time_start`. |
| `--time-end TS` | text |  | Sets the upper time bound; `cli_read_core::inspect_call` adds it to the `inspect` filter as `time_end`. |
| `--limit N` | uint | `50` | Caps the result page; defaults to 50 when omitted; a limit above 200 is lowered to 200. |
| `--offset N` | uint | `0` | Skips this many leading results; `cli_read_core::inspect_call` parses it with `parse_u64` for `inspect`, which defaults it to 0 when omitted. |
| `--include-discarded` |  |  | Includes discarded memories in the listing; `cli_read_core::inspect_call` adds `include_discarded` as true to the filter. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio inspect --validity active --db ./memory.db
```

```
clio inspect --category persona -o json --db ./memory.db
```

the filter JSON takes the same keys as the flags
```
clio inspect --filter '{"validity":"active"}' --limit 20 --db ./memory.db
```
